verdict.rationale: Mastra's workflow engine (`.then()`, `.branch()`, `.parallel()`, suspend/resume) can compose multi-step processes and agents can use tools, which could be combined to call sub-agents, but there is no explicit documentation of agent-to-agent handoffs, subagents, or crew-style multi-agent orchestration. A community reviewer also noted workflows/branching felt 'clunky' for non-LLM agent logic, suggesting real friction for complex multi-agent flows.
